message:
You know that moment when you're relying on your phone for something important, and it suddenly dies? 😩

We had one of those experiences recently while trying to navigate a new area during a family road trip. Just as we were about to find a local park, our GPS app froze and then went dark. Thankfully, we had a paper map stashed in the glove compartment (a little old school, but it saved the day!).

It reminded us how essential it is to have a back-up plan, especially when it comes to our family’s safety and readiness. Maybe it’s time for a quick family chat about our go-bags and ensuring we have all our important documents ready—just in case. Have any of you had a tech fail at the worst moment? 🤔
